decision.summary: The retained runnable map replaces the thin launch shelf row with two ground-cover morphologies and a deterministic first-kilometre dry-bank mosaic. The matched gameplay frame shows broader right-bank cover and additional woody silhouettes with no visible waterline or camera-clipping defect. The coarse 30 m terrain, barren near left wall, synthetic vegetation, and flat water remain below the photoreal bar.

evidence.capture_path: matched default runnable L_Zambezi gameplay camera with raft and crew

rejected_iterations.reason: Rejected before save: local candidate search failed the 4500/560 minimum-population acceptance gates.
Rejected visually: the broad search met population gates but slope-first scoring still collapsed cover onto easy shelves.
Rejected visually: target anchoring improved the right bank, but the 32-degree low-cover ceiling left gorge slopes unnecessarily bare.

remaining_external_acceptance_gates: Guide and geospatial approval of the playable centerline, stationing, access, portage, and rescue context.
Rights approval for all terrain, imagery, supplied-map, vegetation, and reference inputs.
Higher-resolution full-reach terrain or reviewed field-capture derivative replacing the 30 m DSM approximation.
Southern African gorge-woodland species, density, age, wind, season, and wetness approval.
Production terrain, vegetation, rock, water, breaking-water, foam, spray, mist, and lighting art approval.
Validated seasonal hydraulics, bathymetry, guide lines, hazard readability, and rescue behavior.
Measured packaged desktop and target-VR visual/performance acceptance.
